package.contents: Both local checkpoints, source, tests, configs, docs, recorded results and a per-file SHA-256 manifest

limits: Fresh inference memory measures the PyTorch allocator after warm-up, including model tensors but excluding driver/context and other processes. Historical training reserved-memory snapshots are a separate measurement.
The standalone GPU rehearsal emitted one NMS time-limit warning despite passing all 60 frame contracts; its recorded processing throughput includes the slow call.
Live-camera output had zero retained boxes; it verifies capture, inference and display execution, not detection accuracy.
Model/batch study measures inference cost, not fine-tuned larger-model accuracy or training-batch convergence.
Common-class baseline uses previously inspected validation data and only the two shared classes.
External labels were reviewed by an assistant, not a human; six knife boundaries remain ambiguous and generalization is weak.
Person accuracy on labeled campus footage is unmeasured.
